text:
Late in a settled shift, a short confusion arose while the shift coordinator was handling it. Incident Report: Crate Label Mix-Up at the Companion Animal Travel Desk. A traveler arrived at the counter with a crate tag that did not match the pickup note in the active file, and that created a brief pause while the team checked the booking record and the handoff notes. The pet itself was calm, and the traveler was reassured right away that the situation was being reviewed. The desk followed the usual care path used by Aurelia Skyways, starting with a calm check of the reservation details, the crate label, and the shipping handoff. <<FACT F118>> The shift coordinator then contacted the baggage side of the operation and confirmed that the crate had already been routed to the correct animal holding area, while the tag issue was limited to a paperwork mismatch. The traveler was told what the team had found in clear, plain language, and the crate was kept under watch until the paperwork was matched up. No animal welfare issue was seen, and no delay in care was allowed to build up.

After the label mismatch was understood, the desk corrected the record, added a note for the receiving crew, and shared a simple reminder with the handoff staff to check tag details before release. The traveler was given a steady update and left with confidence that the pet was in safe hands. The shift coordinator also reviewed the interaction with the next team on duty so the same point could be checked again at pickup. The follow-up action was practical and calm, with no special measures needed beyond the normal review steps. This was handled smoothly, and the case closed without further concern. Companion Animal Travel Desk
